resources.string: Amanani abikwa ngu-Android futhi ancike ekusekelweni komshayeli. I-positive current isho ukushaja; i-negative current isho ukukhipha. Ishaja esele akuwona umthamo ogcwele webhethri. Impilo yisimo esibikwe ngu-Android, hhayi isilinganiso sokuguga kwebhethri.
Izinguquko azisebenziswa kabusha ekuqaleni. Android kanye namandla HAL angakwazi ukulungisa imikhawulo ngenkathi usebenzisa ifoni. Amafrikhwensi afundwa ku-kernel yale divayisi.
Buyisela imikhawulo yemvamisa nama-cores aku-inthanethi arekhodiwe uma le nqubo yohlelo lokusebenza iqala ukuyifunda. Iswishi eshisayo ihlukene.
Leli qoqo alixhunyiwe ku-inthanethi noma izilawuli zalo zokuvama azikwazi ukufundwa.

Ushintsho lusetshenzisiwe futhi lwaqinisekiswa. Isistimu ingase ilungise lawa manani.
Ukulawula CPU okuceliwe akutholakali. Vuselela isikrini bese uzama futhi.
I-kernel ayisakhangisi leyo mvamisa. Khetha eyodwa yamanani atholakalayo njengamanje.
Ubuncane abukwazi ukudlula umkhawulo. Lungisa omunye umkhawulo kuqala.
Okungenani ingqikithi eyodwa kufanele ihlale iku-inthanethi kuqoqo ngalinye.
I-kernel inqabile ushintsho. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzame ukubuyisela amanani adlule.
Amanani aceliwe awazange aqhubeke esetshenziswa. Enye ingxenye yesistimu kungenzeka izishintshile. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzame ukubuyisela amanani adlule.
%1$s Amanani adlule awakwazanga ukubuyiselwa ngokugcwele. Hlola amanani aboniswe ngezansi noma qalisa kabusha.

Ukusebenzisa ububanzi kukhiya ku-kernel uma kusekelwa. Android ayikwazi ukuyishintsha uze ukhulule isikhiya. CPU amakepisi amafrikhwensi ashisayo nawo angadlula; imikhawulo yehadiwe isasebenza. Qalisa kabusha ikhipha izingidi.
Le kernel ayinikezi ukukhiya imvamisa. Faka i-kernel ngosekelo lwe-Xiaomi Parts ukuze uphoqelele imikhawulo yakho. Izinguquko lapha zingezesikhashana kuze kube yileso sikhathi.
Android ayikwazi ukumiselela lobu bubanzi. Vala ukuze ubuyisele ukulawula kusistimu.
Android ingalungisa imikhawulo. Vula ukuze ubambe ububanzi obubonisiwe.
Ibanga lefrikhwensi elikhethiwe CPU lihlala likhiyiwe uze uyivule noma uyiqalise kabusha ifoni. Lokhu kungakhipha CPU imikhawulo yefrikhwensi ebekwe izilawuli zokushisa zesofthiwe.
Ukukhiya imvamisa akutholakali kule kernel. Android ingamiselela ububanzi besikhashana.

Itholakala RAM ihlanganisa inkumbulo Android ingafuna futhi. Android iphatha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezigcinwe kunqolobane ngokuzenzakalela. Shintsha kanye nemininingwane zRAM iboniswa kuphela uma ifundeka.

Cela ukuthi Android kumiswe izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakwe kunqolobane ezisohlwini olungezansi. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo, izinhlelo zokusebenza zesistimu, izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphikelelayo nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezabelana nge-UID azifakiwe.
Azikho izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakwe kunqolobane ezifanele
Cela ukuthi Android ime %1$s ngemuva? Umsebenzi wangemuva ongalondoloziwe ungase ulahleke. Uhlelo lokusebenza lungaqala kabusha ngokuzenzakalelayo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenze zizokweqiwa.

Akukho ukufundwa kwezinga lokushisa okutholakalayo. Izinzwa ezingekho azilokothi ziboniswe njengoziro.

Amagama ezinzwa aphuma ku-Android kanye ne-kernel. U-Tetris\'s HAL ubika okufanayo SoC ubuningi CPU, GPU, NPU, TPU kanye no-SoC; lezi akuzona izilinganiso ezihlukene. CPU kanye namakhadi GPU akhetha izindawo ezikhonjiwe ze-kernel uma zitholakala. Android isimo esishisayo yisimo esibikwe isistimu, hhayi ukuhlola okuzimele kokuphepha, futhi kungenzeka singabonisi izilawuli ezishisayo ezibhalwe ngaphezulu.

Kufika emaminithini amabili, kuthathwe isampula njalo ngemizuzwana emibili ngenkathi leli khasi libonakala. Ishadi likala kumanani akaliwe; izikhala zibonisa amasampula angatholakali noma ukumiswa okwesikhashana.
